messages:
Rhea (finance): Quick policy update: starting Mar 1, one-time vendor invoices > $5k require a finance sign-off before AP processes. Please route via #help-finance with vendor ID.
Victor (procurement): Note: this doesn't affect recurring subscriptions under existing POs. It's for ad-hoc one-offs only.
Ben (eng): Does this change affect contractor invoices submitted as vendor invoices?
Rhea (finance): Yes  contractor invoices that appear as vendor invoices count. If monthly contractor spend is expected > $5k, request a standing PO instead.
Asha (sales): Whats the expected turnaround for sign-off? We sometimes need quick partner payouts.
Rhea (finance): Target SLA is 48 business hours. For urgent requests, tag "expedite" and include a short justification in the ticket.
notify-bot: Reminder: help-finance ticket template updated at 10:00 UTC. Required fields: vendor_id, invoice_amount, owner_email, expedite_flag.
Victor (procurement): Small process tip: if you foresee frequent one-offs, ask procurement for a vendor relationship setup to avoid delays.
Ben (eng): Got it, thanks. Will check our contractor invoices and open tickets where needed.
Rhea (finance): Thanks all. We'll post a short FAQ in #announcements later today with examples.
